summary: Iteration 7 testing complete for code quality review fixes. Found and fixed a critical React hook dependency bug in AdminDashboard.js. All 15 backend tests passed, all 4 frontend tests passed after fix.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: React hook dependency error - 'Cannot access fetchDailySchedule before initialization' in AdminDashboard.js
Root cause: useEffect hooks at lines 110-140 referenced useCallback functions that were defined AFTER them (lines 210, 226, 580, 901, 912)
Fix: Moved all useEffect hooks to AFTER all useCallback function definitions they reference
✅ Backend health check: GET /api/health returns healthy status
✅ Admin login via httpOnly cookie: POST /api/admin/login with lrobe/L1964c10$ works correctly
✅ Admin verify via cookie: GET /api/admin/verify returns admin info
✅ Admin protected endpoints work with cookie: pending-payments, pending-quotes, daily-schedule
✅ Quote creation: POST /api/quotes/image returns valid quote with scale_level and total_price
✅ Frontend admin login flow: navigate to /admin, login, dashboard loads with 'Welcome back, Lee Robertson'
✅ Frontend homepage loads: hero section and quote flow renders correctly
✅ Admin logout: click logout button, redirected to login page
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fixed critical React hook dependency bug in AdminDashboard.js. The useEffect hooks were referencing useCallback functions before they were defined. Moved all useEffect hooks to after all useCallback definitions. Admin authentication uses httpOnly cookie-based session management. Cookie name is 'admin_session'. All admin endpoints are protected by middleware except /admin/login and /admin/init.
